questions: What semantic fields select each entry in the specialized skin/copy dispatch tables rooted at 0x2c07f9c8, 0x2c07fc08, and 0x2c07fc28?
Do all specialization-table entries transform vertices on the CPU, or does an unobserved entry upload matrices to a hardware skinning path?
Which material or packed-vertex decode path causes the observed rainbow theatre cloth independently of skeletal pose?

field_probes.label: bone_to_world_buffer
field_probes.role: Enumerates CStudioRender users of the buffer filled by the client SetupBones callback.

field_probes.label: skin_palette
field_probes.role: Enumerates CStudioRender users of the boneToWorld * poseToBone palette and retains destructor false leads.

findings.fact: engine.dll loads StudioRender.dll and acquires TStudioRender012.
findings.consequence: The final skeletal matrix and vertex-skinning implementation is isolated behind this interface.

findings.fact: engine.dll uses TStudioRender012 slot +0x40 to obtain the bone output buffer and slot +0x58 to submit model drawing.
findings.consequence: These two slots are the durable StudioRender entry points for the remaining trace.

findings.fact: TStudioRender012 slot +0x40 returns the CStudioRender bone-to-world buffer at this+0x5c, and slot +0x58 is CStudioRender::DrawModel.
findings.consequence: The client SetupBones callback writes its result directly into CStudioRender-owned storage.

findings.fact: CStudioRender builds a second palette at this+0x60 using skinMatrix[i] = boneToWorld[i] * StudioBone[i].poseToBone.
findings.evidence: StudioRender.dll 0x2c004e10 loops StudioHdr.NumBones and calls matrix concat 0x2c00eba0 with this+0x5c, StudioBone+0x58, and this+0x60.
findings.consequence: The v2531 poseToBone matrix is proven to be the inverse bind and its retail multiplication order is known.

findings.fact: Both ordinary mesh branches call a specialization dispatcher that passes the this+0x60 skin palette into generated vertex routines.
findings.evidence: StudioRender.dll 0x2c01c3b0 and 0x2c01bf50 call 0x2c01aaf0; 0x2c01aaf0 dispatches through tables rooted at 0x2c07f9c8, 0x2c07fc08, and 0x2c07fc28.
findings.consequence: The final palette is consumed while constructing the submitted mesh rather than being discarded after DrawModel.

findings.fact: Observed specialization entries skin vertices on the CPU, blending one to four palette matrices by byte weights and applying the result to positions and normals.
findings.evidence: StudioRender.dll 0x2c01aff0, table entry 0x2c01e4e0, direct flex path 0x2c01cb60, and packed-vertex table entry 0x2c04cdb0.
findings.consequence: Retail deformation confirms the same bone indices and weights decoded from StudioVertex; a hidden transpose or reversed inverse-bind order is not required.

findings.fact: 0x2c0054f0 reads this+0x60 only while destroying CStudioRender.
findings.evidence: The function restores vtable 0x2c06c150, frees member arrays and this+0x60, and optionally deletes this.
findings.consequence: It is not a render-time palette upload or draw consumer.

functions.label: c_studiorender_ctor
functions.role: Initializes the static TStudioRender012 object at 0x2c082b30 and installs its runtime vtable.

functions.label: c_studiorender_drawmodel
functions.role: CStudioRender::DrawModel; TStudioRender012 slot +0x58 reached from engine CModelRender::RenderModel.

functions.label: c_studiorender_get_bone_buffer
functions.role: TStudioRender012 slot +0x40; engine calls this immediately before the client SetupBones callback to obtain its output buffer.

functions.label: c_studiorender_build_skin_palette
functions.role: Loops every studio bone and computes this+0x60 skin matrices as boneToWorld * poseToBone.

functions.label: c_studiorender_draw_meshes
functions.role: Walks model meshes and chooses the ordinary, flexed, and material-specific draw branches.

functions.label: dispatch_specialized_vertex_skin
functions.role: Selects a generated vertex skin/copy routine and passes the this+0x60 palette into it.

functions.label: blend_vertex_skin_matrix
functions.role: Returns or constructs the weighted blend of one to four skin matrices selected by a vertex's bone indices and byte weights.

functions.label: specialized_vertex_skin_entry
functions.role: Representative generated entry from table 0x2c07f9c8; blends the vertex skin matrix, transforms position and normal, and advances dynamic-mesh streams.

functions.label: specialized_packed_vertex_entry
functions.role: Representative entry from table 0x2c07fc08; decodes packed position/normal/UV data, applies the supplied skin matrix, and advances dynamic-mesh streams.

functions.label: cpu_flexed_mesh_skin
functions.role: Direct CPU path that selects up to four this+0x60 matrices, blends transformed positions and normals by byte weights, and writes dynamic vertices.

functions.label: c_studiorender_destructor
functions.role: Frees the this+0x60 palette and other owned arrays; retained to prevent repeating the false palette-consumer lead.
